Jersey palette fixtures for `test/pc-jersey.js` and `test/browser/jed.js`.

- `HOMEPALS95.BIN`, `AWAYPALS95.BIN`: NHL 95 PC originals (JED 3.01's `HOMEPALS.O95` / `AWAYPALS.O95`), 28 × 448 bytes.
- `HOMEPALS94.BIN`, `AWAYPALS94.BIN`: NHL 94 PC retail (`pc94/` in EA-NHL-Tools Sprite-Viewer), 26 × 448 bytes.
